#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""τ Sensitivity Sweep — dual Y-axis plot."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pathlib

tau = [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95]
ppl = [17.688, 17.6805, 17.6793, 17.6527, 17.712, 17.723]
bstar_mean = [0.3923, 0.5899, 0.8943, 1.399, 2.36, 3.0775]

uniform_ppl = 17.694
best_idx = ppl.index(min(ppl))

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.labelsize": 10,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.05,
})

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.6))

ax1.axhspan(min(ppl) - 0.01, max(ppl) + 0.01, xmin=0, xmax=(0.8 - 0.45) / (1.0 - 0.45),
            alpha=0.08, color="green", zorder=0)
safe_left, safe_right = 0.5, 0.8
ax1.axvspan(safe_left, safe_right, alpha=0.10, color="green", zorder=0, label="Safe range")

ax1.axhline(y=uniform_ppl, color="grey", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax1.annotate("Uniform baseline", xy=(0.95, uniform_ppl), fontsize=7, color="grey",
             ha="right", va="bottom", xycoords=("data", "data"))

ln1 = ax1.plot(tau, ppl, "o-", color="#2166ac", markersize=5, linewidth=1.5,
               label="Held-out PPL", zorder=3)
ax1.annotate(f"best τ={tau[best_idx]}",
             xy=(tau[best_idx], ppl[best_idx]),
             xytext=(tau[best_idx] + 0.06, ppl[best_idx] - 0.015),
             fontsize=7, color="#2166ac",
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#2166ac", lw=0.8),
             zorder=4)

ax1.set_xlabel("Threshold τ")
ax1.set_ylabel("Held-out PPL", color="#2166ac")
ax1.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor="#2166ac")
ax1.set_xlim(0.45, 1.0)
ax1.set_xticks(tau)

ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ln2 = ax2.plot(tau, bstar_mean, "^-", color="#b2182b", markersize=5, linewidth=1.5,
               label="Mean $b^*$", zorder=3)
ax2.set_ylabel("Mean $b^*$", color="#b2182b")
ax2.tick_params(axis="y", labelcolor="#b2182b")

lns = ln1 + ln2
labs = [l.get_label() for l in lns]
ax1.legend(lns, labs, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="none", fontsize=7)

fig.tight_layout()

out = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "artifacts" / "figures"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(out / "tau_sweep.pdf")
fig.savefig(out / "tau_sweep.png", dpi=300)
print(f"Saved to {out / 'tau_sweep.pdf'} and .png")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""b* distribution — 4-bin bar chart with mean/median markers."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pathlib

bins = ["[0, 0.5)", "[0.5, 1)", "[1, 2)", "[2, 20]"]
pcts = [20.9, 35.7, 27.3, 16.1]
colors = ["#d1e5f0", "#6baed6", "#2171b5", "#08306b"]

mean_val = 1.399
median_val = 0.871

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.labelsize": 10,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.05,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.4))

x = np.arange(len(bins))
bars = ax.bar(x, pcts, color=colors, edgecolor="white", width=0.7, zorder=2)

for bar, pct in zip(bars, pcts):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() + 0.8,
            f"{pct:.1f}%", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8, fontweight="bold")

median_x = 1 + (median_val - 0.5) / 0.5 * 0.7 - 0.35
mean_x = 2 + (mean_val - 1.0) / 1.0 * 0.7 - 0.35

def bin_to_x(val):
    if val < 0.5:
        return 0 + val / 0.5 * 0.7 - 0.35
    elif val < 1.0:
        return 1 + (val - 0.5) / 0.5 * 0.7 - 0.35
    elif val < 2.0:
        return 2 + (val - 1.0) / 1.0 * 0.7 - 0.35
    else:
        return 3 + (val - 2.0) / 18.0 * 0.7 - 0.35

med_x = bin_to_x(median_val)
mean_x = bin_to_x(mean_val)

ax.axvline(med_x, color="#e41a1c", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
ax.axvline(mean_x, color="#ff7f00", linestyle="-.", linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)

ax.annotate(f"median={median_val:.2f}", xy=(med_x, 38), fontsize=7,
            color="#e41a1c", ha="left", va="top", rotation=0,
            xytext=(med_x + 0.15, 38))
ax.annotate(f"mean={mean_val:.2f}", xy=(mean_x, 35), fontsize=7,
            color="#ff7f00", ha="left", va="top", rotation=0,
            xytext=(mean_x + 0.15, 35))

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(bins)
ax.set_xlabel("$b^*$ range")
ax.set_ylabel("Percentage of batches (%)")
ax.set_ylim(0, 42)
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

fig.tight_layout()

out = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "artifacts" / "figures"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(out / "bstar_distribution.pdf")
fig.savefig(out / "bstar_distribution.png", dpi=300)
print(f"Saved to {out / 'bstar_distribution.pdf'} and .png")
